title: microrhynchus spinosus
intro: Microrhynchus spinosus, commonly known as the "hairy trident," is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its traditional use in folk medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, potentially aiding in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Microrhynchus spinosus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
